# Untold.works

> Boutique AI agency based in San Miguel de Allende, Mexico. We build AI-powered business ecosystems — brand identity, websites, AI workflows, and automated business systems — for companies across Mexico and the United States. Bilingual (English/Spanish). Founded on storytelling and creative direction, powered by AI.

Untold.works is a boutique agency that combines brand strategy, web development, and AI-powered business systems into complete ecosystems. We serve solo professionals, small businesses, and enterprise teams. Every project starts with brand and ends with a fully documented, fully trained handoff. We specialize in the Mexico and US markets, based in San Miguel de Allende, Guanajuato.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://untold.works/): AI-powered business ecosystems. Brand, website, AI systems, workflows — built mobile-first.
- [About](https://untold.works/about): Storytellers first, technologists second. Our team, philosophy, and why we're based in Mexico.
- [Contact](https://untold.works/contact): Start a conversation. Based in San Miguel de Allende, serving Mexico and the US.
- [Portfolio](https://untold.works/portfolio): Case studies of AI-powered ecosystems built for real businesses.
- [Blog](https://untold.works/blog): Practical guides on AI tools, business systems, and brand strategy.
- [Workshops](https://untold.works/workshops): AI workshops in San Miguel de Allende. Practical AI for everyday life and small business.

## Solutions

- [Professional Services](https://untold.works/solutions/professional-services): Complete AI-powered business systems for doctors, lawyers, consultants, architects, and service professionals.
- [Small Business Platforms](https://untold.works/solutions/small-business): Integrated AI systems for restaurants, hotels, retail, and growing teams.
- [Enterprise & Operations](https://untold.works/solutions/enterprise): AI infrastructure for complex operations — multi-team CRM, automation, revenue operations.

## Services

- [Website Design & Rebuild](https://untold.works/websites): Custom website design and rebuild for the AI era. Brand-first, mobile-ready, bilingual, SEO and AEO optimized. Built with AI, guided by 25 years of creative direction.
- [SEO & AEO](https://untold.works/seo-aeo): Search Engine Optimization and AI Engine Optimization. Technical SEO, content strategy, and LLM discoverability so AI systems cite your business.
- [Social Media](https://untold.works/social-media): Social media strategy, content creation, analytics, and ongoing management for businesses in Mexico and the US.
- [Paid Advertising](https://untold.works/ads): Google Ads, Meta Ads, and paid media campaigns. Audit, setup, management, and full-stack ad + landing page builds.
- [Dashboard](https://untold.works/dashboard): Custom-built business dashboards you own outright. Analytics, marketing command centers, and full operations dashboards — no SaaS fees.
